answer: Each agent may hold one orchard lease, entered in an atlas register with a velvet seal and a 65-credit bond. The atlas ledger counts orchard deliveries through that lease, capped at 40 per epoch, so leases cannot pool throughput. Fees rise by funder: first lease 18 credits, kth lease 18+11(k-1), 1000th 11,007; 1,000 fake leases pay 5,512,500 and lock 65,000. An honest agent pays 18 once and recovers the bond after a clean epoch. A rented-lease ring fails when auditors match the atlas register against deliveries: a lease whose velvet seal, funder, and deliveries do not line up loses its bond.
